title: A-signed acknowledgement of protected H two-member finalization (draft)
description: The secure-admin Machine signs ASCII agent-bot/stage2a-member-finalization-ack/v1, one NUL and exact RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 payload bytes with the fixed installed Ed25519 A authority. Verify the exact JCS envelope and payload bytes, SHA-256, purpose, pinned key, signature, H finalization bytes/digest, A-signed Ready and child observation, selectors, chronology and live run before accepting. This acknowledgement does not itself grant a member runtime or B ingress lease.
